# Stasis shatter clears its own ability and restores Fight Club

Natural sample16 Ring6, turn7, input46 activates StasisCrystal's shatter
ability(card38,Sentient unit2,equipment9). Native removes Untouchable,
the ability definition and four common triggers, leaving two authored triggers.
The equipment remains attached; no cooldown is added. FightClub restores its
f93ac9f7-45d2-47a4-a159-a1b326bd047f room upgrade, raising attack20 to35.

The previous lifecycle published status removal but left its final definition
and trigger removal out of the shared world. The following manager callback
refreshed the stale actor and reset cooldown. Publish the final lifecycle state
before draining callbacks. Ability completion also synchronizes targetability
for the two independently calibrated EnchantedChamber/FightClub room payloads.

The original46-input counterexample, exact45-input prefix plus shatter and
independent repaired native replay pass full state, forecasts and RNG.
Four concurrent branches preserve their parent; four altered room payloads
remain unsupported. Existing lifecycle checks and the earlier12-input native
removed-actor/self-target pair also pass. This is not a Ring6 victory.
